title: Raise validator timeout for large corpora
rationale: A real corpus run timed out at 180s while the validator was still checking evidence resolution. The default should be 300s, with a hard cap.

change.rollback: Revert the default to 180 and rerun the validator test.

expected_effect: Large corpora complete validation without a timeout while the upper bound stays bounded.

verification.expected: All tests pass and the real corpus produces a report under 300s.
